title: Built an AI agent for regulated requirements
summary: I built an AI agent that takes requirements from ambiguous to reviewable and checks them against IEC 62304 and FDA guidance, then presented it to the software technical advisory board.
what_would_have_happened: Requirement gaps would surface late in reviews and audits.
the_call: Keep a person deciding; let the agent point to evidence.
what_i_did: Built the agent and its analysis prompts, and presented it to the software technical advisory board.
what_changed: Other teams requested access; it later became an official asset of the company's AI platform.
